objective: Evaluate transfer of the locked real-gas adiabatic vessel-discharge model to an independent Sandia/SRI high-pressure vessel pressure-decay trace.
claim_boundary: This holdout tests time-resolved vessel pressure in one 43.1 MPa hydrogen blowdown from a 1.234 m3 vessel through the published 5.08 mm restriction. It does not validate flame geometry, radiation, dispersion, mass flow instrumentation, 70-90 MPa storage, refuelling control, or a complete station loop.

source.title: Characterization of high-pressure, underexpanded hydrogen-jet flames
source.digitization_license: GNU GPL v3 as distributed with HyRAM+; publisher figure remains cited to the original DOI
source.redistribution_policy: Commit a verbatim derived-data copy only with HyRAM+ attribution, GPL notice and original paper citation. Do not commit a publisher PDF.

known_before_freeze.data_file_access_before_freeze: The data file was cryptographically hashed but no numerical row was opened. Public HyRAM+ test setup code supplied only apparatus inputs and the x1/y1/x2/y2 structure.

independence.limitation: The HyRAM+ CSV is a publisher-figure digitization rather than an original logger export. The same research partnership produced the 2006 development-adjacent and 2007 holdout experiments, so this is an experiment-level rather than institution-level transfer test.

locked_model.description: Well-mixed adiabatic rigid vessel with HEOS hydrogen properties and maximum real-gas isentropic mass flux through the published 5.08 mm restriction; Cd=1.0 from the public benchmark setup; no outcome fitting.

requires: trace assembled from the two publisher Figure 4 experimental segments without extrapolation
eligibility.insufficient_data_policy: Archive an ineligible result without substituting a plotted calculation or extrapolating beyond measured support.

median_absolute_percentage_error_percent.support: measured pressure at least 10 percent of initial measured pressure

aggregate_decision.claim_supported: all three primary endpoint screens pass
aggregate_decision.negative_result_policy: Any failed screen remains archived and prohibits an independent pressure-decay validation claim from this dataset.
